scope: Private one-role mutation and cohort UID reservation in one SQLite transaction, followed by saved project maintenance
developmentFixes: The first complete server run failed 22 unrelated npm-pack and plugin-build tests because the sandbox denied writes to the user-owned npm cache; overriding the cache environment was stripped by the command runner. The same unchanged 3845-test suite passed outside the sandbox.

The new removal regression initially assumed a fixed UUID sort order; it now compares the two required participant identities without depending on random UUID order. The final database suite passes 695 tests.
limitations: The role change entry remains private; no administrator HTTP, SDK, CLI or UI contract is exposed.
The Docker role-change scenario verifies runner grant; removal is covered by migrated SQLite tests and the earlier direct ACL revocation scenario.
Actual shared native Qwen project execution remains closed.
Postcommit failure keeps the saved operation and UID barriers until reconciliation; it does not roll the role change back.
